description:
Streaks makes building a habit feel like a game you actually want to win. Add the little things you want to do every day, tap the ring when you've done them, and watch your streak climb.

Every habit gets its own colour and icon, a seven-day strip so you can see your week at a glance, and a flame that lights up when today is done. Open a habit to see your current streak, your best streak ever, your total check-ins and a five-week calendar. Forgot to tick yesterday? Tap the day to fix it.

Finish everything and you get a Perfect Day. No accounts, no nagging, no clutter. Just you, your habits, and one more day on the streak.
whatsNew: New check-off animation, best-streak tracking and a five-week calendar you can edit.
